skill.heartbound.wind_kiss.desc: Blow a kiss at what you look at: for 8 s it is yours - it turns on the foes nearest it and spares you and yours. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.thorn_garden.desc: Black roses and thorns grow round where you look, 3.5 blocks wide, for 6 s: every foe in them takes Wither II and is slowed. Nothing of it is a block. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.slime_bounce.desc: Leap up and along where you look, and come down in a splash: every foe within 3.5 blocks takes 120% of your attack and is stuck in place. From the ground only. 8 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.ember_breath.desc: Breathe a cone of embers 5 blocks long where you look: every foe in it takes 80% of your attack and burns for 4 s. Only creatures burn; no block catches. 12 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.plush_lullaby.desc: Sing over where you look: for 8 s, five blocks round, every foe there is slow and weak, and everyone of yours there mends and is hard to hurt. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.full_bloom.desc: A great flower opens about you: everyone of yours within 8 blocks mends 4 hearts and is cleared of every ill; every foe in the petals is slowed for 4 s. 40 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.pixie_dust.desc: Scatter your dust: everyone of yours within 6 blocks falls slowly and moves fast for 10 s; every foe there glows for 5 s and is lifted off its feet for a moment. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.overclock.desc: For 10 s, you and everyone of yours within 8 blocks work and fight like machines: Haste II and Strength I. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.shield_wall.desc: A dome of shields 4 blocks round you for 5 s, going with you: nothing shot at you or yours inside it lands, and a blow by hand does half. When it falls, every foe within 5 blocks is thrown back. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.dash.desc: Bolt where you look: 3 s of Speed III and Jump Boost, and your first blow within that lands double. 12 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.infernal_meteor.desc: Two seals open over where you look, holding your foes under them in Slowness III; then a meteor falls out of the sky seal, bursting 6 blocks wide for three of your Hellfire Hearts, throwing everything out and setting it alight. In soul-fire during Queen Reborn. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.answering_heart.desc: The Moon Fox rises behind you for 20 s: violet lightning falls on what you look at every second and on whatever your blows and arrows land on, leaping on to 3 more foes. When it ends a great bolt falls on the last of them and breaks the ground. 50 s cooldown.

Use it again while they stand to loose the next one at once, one a press: hunting down what you look at, or, with nothing there, straight along your look. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.ephemeral_transcendence: For 20 s your five swords never come home between blows: they go through what you look at, loop, and go through again, onto the next foe when it dies; twelve guard swords circle you and cut down anything shot at you. 50 s cooldown.

text.autoconfig.heartbound.option.base.c: A girl who fells a tree brings its canopy down with it instead of leaving the leaves to vanilla's slow random decay. Player-placed leaves are never touched.
Boob Window
Disable Shading
Makes the armor on the girls have a window to see their breast
Disables the shading/shadows on the girls and makes them have flat lighting
Jiggle Physics (Master)

ON: boobs/belly/butt are fully driven by the physics system (per-step bounce, inertia, breathing, squash & stretch) and override their animations. OFF: physics is disabled and the default animations play untouched.
Boob Jiggle Physics
Butt Jiggle Physics
Enables breast jiggle physics. Turn off to disable it.
Enables butt jiggle physics. Turn off to disable it.
Walking Bounce (%)
How hard the physics adds its own bounce to every step while walking or running. 0 turns it off, 100 is the original strength, 200 is twice that. Only takes effect while "Tune Walking Bounce" is on.
Tune Walking Bounce
On: the walking bounce follows the percentage above, and fades out on walk animations that already bob the body so the two never stack. Off: the physics behaves exactly as it originally did.
Idle Variation Chance (%)

Girls (and players who are one) stand in their plain idle. After three seconds standing still, each second has this chance of playing one of their idle0..idleN once before going back to idle. Anything else she does cuts it short. 0 turns it off.
Cull Back Faces

Draws only the outward side of each face, the way Blockbench previews a model with "Render Sides: Outside". Fixes the flickering texture on flat parts of a model, where the two sides sit at the same depth and neither can win. Turn off if a model relies on being seen from the inside.
Spectacle Camera Shake
When one of Hsin's Xuanfang spectacles lands its blow, the camera shakes and the view kicks wide, harder the closer you are and the harder the blow.
Spectacle Screen Flash
When one of Hsin's Xuanfang spectacles lands its blow, the screen flashes in the mansion's colour.
Spectacle Sky Darkening
While the stars of a Xuanfang spectacle descend, the sky and the world around go dark and the constellation shines in it.

attribute.heartbound.trait.scholar.desc: Learns much faster, would rather not fight.
attribute.heartbound.trait.early_bird.de: To bed and up again an hour and a half early.

attribute.heartbound.signature.forgehear: Tools in her hands never wear out.
attribute.heartbound.signature.ore_sense: Every strike at an ore node yields double.
attribute.heartbound.signature.timber.de: Every log she fells drops one more.
Baby animals near her grow up five times as fast.
attribute.heartbound.signature.silver_to: A sold-out villager still finds one more deal for her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.verdant.d: Crops within four blocks of her grow while she works.
Hostiles that go for her owner turn on her instead. When too many are after her owner she shouts them all onto herself for five seconds, and takes a third less while she holds them.
attribute.heartbound.signature.amphibiou: Water is hers: she never drowns, swims at half again her running pace, and whatever hits her there does half. At what she fights a few blocks off she rides the riptide: a surge that carries her through, sweeping every foe in the way and leaving it slow.
attribute.heartbound.signature.dark_dwel: In the dark (light below 7) she takes half damage and moves a quarter faster. Out of the dark with a foe near, she draws the night about her for eight seconds, wherever she is, and every foe within eight blocks is plunged into it.
attribute.heartbound.signature.phoenix.d: Once a day, a killing blow leaves her at full health where she stands, in a burst of flame, instead of sending her home. Failing with a foe on her, she calls the flame herself: half her health back, every ill burned off, and every foe within four blocks scorched and alight.
attribute.heartbound.signature.blink.des: Following her owner and left twelve blocks behind, she is simply beside her owner again.
attribute.heartbound.signature.juggernau: Nothing moves her and nothing sticks: immune to knockback and to every harmful effect. At what she fights a few blocks off she bulldozes: a charge with Resistance II, every foe in the way flung aside.
Her first blow on any creature lands double. She marks what she fights when it is off: it glows wherever it goes, her blows on it land harder, and she has the legs to run it down.
attribute.heartbound.signature.gourmet.d: Every meal heals twice as much. As a fight begins with her owner near she serves a spiced meal: Strength, Speed and Regeneration for everyone of hers within eight blocks.
attribute.heartbound.signature.thunderbo: Lightning cannot hurt her, and one hit in six calls a bolt down on what she struck. Every twenty seconds she calls the storm itself on what she fights, forking onto what stands near it.
Every ten seconds her foes within ten blocks are weakened for five just by her being there. Before a crowd she decrees: everything that dreads her within ten blocks is brought to its knees, and everyone of hers takes heart.
attribute.heartbound.signature.shadowste: At night, hostiles lose sight of her unless she has struck within the last five seconds. Hard pressed, she vanishes for five seconds, day or night, and her first blow out of it lands double.
attribute.heartbound.signature.spidercli: She climbs walls the way a spider does. At what she fights she throws a web that holds it and everything within three blocks of it fast for four seconds, and she is on it in a bound.
attribute.heartbound.signature.strider.d: She walks on lava, and fire cannot touch her. At what she fights before her she throws up a surge of magma five blocks long: every foe in it burned and alight. Nothing of the world catches.
attribute.heartbound.signature.frost_wal: Still water under her feet freezes as she passes, and thaws behind her. With a foe on her she throws the cold out over five blocks: every foe in it frozen where it stands for three seconds, and every still water in it ice.
attribute.heartbound.signature.magnet.de: Dropped items within six blocks drift to her. Under a crowd she pulls: every item and orb within sixteen blocks comes to her, every foe within eight is dragged three blocks in and off its feet, and every arrow in the air is turned aside.
Her stomach never drops below six: she is never too hungry to work. When someone of hers is hungry or hurt she lays a feast: everyone within eight blocks fed full on the spot, with Regeneration and Absorption on top.
attribute.heartbound.signature.hibernato: Waking fully fed: her sleep is a meal. Hurt with nothing on her, she drops into a deep rest for three seconds and wakes with half her health back, every ill gone and a spring in her step; her drowsiness is catching on every foe within six blocks.
attribute.heartbound.signature.last_stan: Below a quarter health she cannot be hurt for five seconds, once a minute. Failing with foes about, she stands firm: four seconds in which nothing hurts her and nothing moves her, and a moment spent after.
attribute.heartbound.signature.escape_ar: Below a quarter health she goes home at once, once a minute. Hurt with a foe on her, she throws a smoke bomb: every foe within four blocks blinded and forgetful, and she eight blocks off before it clears.
attribute.heartbound.signature.iron_grip: When a blow would send her home, she keeps every item she carries. What is on her she seizes in a fist of iron for three seconds: it goes nowhere, and her blows on it land harder.
attribute.heartbound.signature.mirror.de: Every projectile that hits her flies back at whoever fired it, and she feels nothing. Being hit, she raises a shell of mirror for five seconds that throws every blow back whole and lets only half through.
attribute.heartbound.signature.riposte.d: Struck in melee, she strikes back in the same instant. When what she fights is on her she takes her stance: for three seconds no blow by hand lands on her, and each is answered with a cut for half again her attack.
attribute.heartbound.signature.soul_eate: Every kill heals her to full. Hurt, she draws the soul out of what she fights at hand, and every point of it mends her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.execution: Anything below a fifth of its health dies to her next blow. On what is failing at hand she brings the guillotine down: double her attack, and anything under a third of its health is dead.
A blow from behind lands triple. When what she fights faces her she is at its back in a breath of smoke, her knife in it before it has turned.
attribute.heartbound.signature.duelist.d: Alone against a single foe she hits half again as hard. She names the one she fights: for eight seconds it turns on her alone, she takes less from it and gives it more.
attribute.heartbound.signature.giant_sla: Anything with more than forty health takes double from her. At a giant she flings a hooked chain that drags it to her feet and leaves it stunned.
Each blow on the same foe lands a tenth harder than the last, up to double. With her blows flowing she is unstoppable: six seconds at the full double on anything, quick on her feet, and nothing shoves her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.whirlwind: Her blows spill onto every hostile within three blocks of the one she struck, at half. Crowded, she turns a cyclone cut through everything within four blocks of her and throws it all back.
attribute.heartbound.signature.trophy_hu: Every kill is worth ten experience to her. At the start of a fight she sounds her horn: Strength and Speed for everyone of hers within twelve blocks, and every kill of hers worth thirty while it sounds.
attribute.heartbound.signature.gravity_w: Hostiles within six blocks are dragged toward her every second. Under a crowd she opens a singularity that drags everything within six blocks of it into its middle for three seconds, then collapses on them.
Every five seconds, hostiles within four blocks are thrown back. Pressed, she lets go a shockwave that flings everything within six blocks away hard and drops every arrow in the air.
Undead within eight blocks burn as if under the sun. With the undead near she consecrates the ground six blocks about her for ten seconds: they burn and bleed on it, and everyone of hers on it mends.
attribute.heartbound.signature.defuser.d: Creepers within six blocks cannot light their fuse. Under a crowd she sends out a pulse over eight blocks that leaves every foe in it feeble and forgetful, sends the creepers off, and drops every arrow and lit charge.
attribute.heartbound.signature.hive_mind: Girls within sixteen blocks work a tenth faster while she is about. With sisters about her she brings them into synchrony for ten seconds: Haste and Speed for all, their work inspired, and Strength if there is a fight.
attribute.heartbound.signature.medic.des: Girls within six blocks heal half a heart every five seconds; she does not. When someone of hers is failing she dresses the field: everyone within eight blocks, herself too, mended by a third at once and cleared of every ill.
attribute.heartbound.signature.pacesette: Girls within eight blocks move with Speed I. When a fight finds them she calls the march: for eight seconds everyone of hers within twelve blocks goes at the double, springing, and fearing no fall.
attribute.heartbound.signature.warcry.de: Every blow she lands gives the girls within eight blocks Strength I for five seconds. As a fight begins she cries out: Strength II and Resistance for everyone of hers within ten blocks, and the fight taken out of every foe within eight.
attribute.heartbound.signature.lucky_cha: Her owner within eight blocks has Luck. Now and then, with her owner near, she calls down fortune: Luck III for everyone of hers within eight blocks for thirty seconds, and experience spilling from every kill while it lasts.
attribute.heartbound.signature.peoples_c: Her owner within eight blocks is Hero of the Village. When the village is in danger she swears her oath: Heroes of the Village thrice over for everyone of hers, every villager within sixteen blocks mended, and their attackers turned on her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.lantern_e: Her owner within eight blocks sees in the dark at night. At night with foes about she lights her lantern: everyone of hers within twelve blocks sees in the dark for a minute, and every foe within twelve is lit up for all to see.
attribute.heartbound.signature.siren.des: Her owner in water within eight blocks breathes and swims like a dolphin. Before a crowd, or with her owner in the water, she sings: every foe within ten blocks is drawn to her, slow and feeble, and everyone of hers swims like a dolphin.
attribute.heartbound.signature.furnace_s: Her stomach is a furnace: one raw thing in her pack smelts itself every ten seconds.
attribute.heartbound.signature.appraiser: Every trade she makes pays double emeralds.
Saplings within four blocks grow into trees while she is near.
attribute.heartbound.signature.bloom.des: Grass breaks into flowers where she walks.

attribute.heartbound.trait.bloodthirst.d: A third of what she deals comes back as health. Rare.
attribute.heartbound.trait.marker.desc: What she hits glows - nowhere to hide.
attribute.heartbound.trait.grave_fear.de: Hits the undead softer - she would rather not touch them.

attribute.heartbound.effect.eager_haul: Sets out to haul at half the usual load
The Moon Fox divides one into many - one self at the new moon, three at the full. When a fight finds her they step out as fighters, each a whole girl with her traits and fury, and converge after fifteen seconds with half of all they dealt returned to her as health. At peace in her base by day they step out as workers: they join the base for the working day, take whatever the Core deals them, and converge at dusk with their packs handed to her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.infernal_: She fights from the air on a sovereign's wings: fireballs in volleys that grow with her phase - one, then two, then three - her own fire, which burns through resistance and withers what it strikes. From her second phase she lunges and seizes a player, drinking back a tenth of her health, and calls up skeletons; below a third of her health she sacrifices them to mend herself. She side-steps what is shot at her, burns berserk in her last phase, and hostiles near her are weakened and slowed. Flames do not touch her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.fallen_em: What is left of the sovereign in the coin: she fights with fireballs from the air instead of blows, takes wing when she needs to, and hostiles near her are weakened and slowed. Her fireballs set what they strike burning in hellfire (stacking up to 3 times) and split into 3 embers that hunt her foes nearby.
attribute.heartbound.signature.allure.de: She is looked at, and she knows it. A sold-out villager still finds one more deal for her; in a fight, every ten seconds the foe nearest her is taken with her for four and turns on its own; and a kiss blown at one holds it for eight.
attribute.heartbound.signature.wither_ro: The flower she keeps. She never sleeps; her blows wither what they land on, the wither cannot touch her, and she hits a fifth harder by night. She grows a garden of black roses and thorns about a spot: six seconds of Wither II and slowness on every foe in it. Nothing of it is a block.
attribute.heartbound.signature.gelatinou: A body of jelly. She heals half a heart every three seconds, hungry or not; no fall hurts her and she bounces where she lands; what she strikes is stuck for a moment. She leaps at what she fights and comes down in a splash that hurts and sticks every foe about her.
attribute.heartbound.signature.dragonkin: The dragon in her. Every ore seam yields double; her scales turn a tenth of every blow and all fire; near her owner she fights a sixth harder. And she breathes embers: a cone of flame five blocks long that hurts and sets alight every foe in it - and nothing else.
A teddy bear come to life. Baby animals near her grow up five times as fast; everyone of hers within six blocks mends half a heart every five seconds; her body is soft - no fall hurts her and a blow hardly moves her. She sings a plush lullaby over a spot, eight seconds long and five blocks wide: every foe in it is slow and weak, everyone of hers in it mends and is hard to hurt.
attribute.heartbound.signature.sunny_blo: Her love of life. Crops within four blocks grow while she works, and petals drift from her steps. She blooms: a great flower opens about her - everyone of hers within eight blocks mends four hearts and is cleared of every ill, and every foe in the petals is tangled and slowed.
attribute.heartbound.signature.fairy_dus: A jolly blue fairy. She flies, and the dust off her wings mends whoever of hers she flutters by. She scatters it: everyone of hers within six blocks is light as a feather and quick for ten seconds, and every foe in it is lit up and lifted off its feet for a moment.
attribute.heartbound.signature.tinkers_s: The practical one. Tools in her hands never wear, and every five seconds she mends a point of wear off whatever her owner holds near her. She overclocks: for ten seconds everyone of hers within eight blocks has Haste II and Strength I, copper gears turning over their heads.
attribute.heartbound.signature.bulwark.d: The quiet guard. Hostiles that go for her owner turn on her instead, and with someone of hers near she takes a fifth less from every blow. She raises a wall of shields four blocks round her for five seconds: nothing shot at anyone inside it lands and a blow by hand does half; when it falls, every foe about her is thrown back.
attribute.heartbound.signature.trailblaz: The outdoors girl. Every log she fells drops one more; under open sky she moves a sixth faster, and she steps over fences and low walls rather than going round. She bolts: three seconds of Speed III and a spring in her step, and her first blow after lands double.
attribute.heartbound.signature.winged_fl: She walks, and takes wing when she needs to: in a fight, to reach her owner above or below her, or where the ground cannot take her - and glides back down after. She comes to her owner through open air, and never takes a fall.
attribute.heartbound.signature.formless_: Five swords of wind-qi stand fanned behind her. While she fights they leave one after another every five seconds, arc onto her target wherever it runs, and fly home to their places; each lays a stack of Mindlock - up to fifteen, each making it take more from the swords. At full Mindlock her next volley is Heaven's Reckoning: all five rise into a ring above it, turn their points down and fall together. Her swords do her fighting, so she fights from range: she keeps her distance and faces her foe, shoots to help if she has a bow, and closes only when something is on her and she has a weapon.
attribute.heartbound.trait.heart_of_thun: The thunder she keeps in her heart: her blows carry it, one in five lands as a bolt, and lightning is hers to command, never to fear.
attribute.heartbound.trait.dustless_trea: The fox's step: nothing that means her harm can keep its eye on her until she strikes, nothing underfoot slows her, and the moon quickens her.
attribute.heartbound.trait.illumining_he: A heart that lights itself: a heart mended every five seconds, no darkness takes her sight, and when she is badly hurt she is hardest to hurt further.
attribute.heartbound.trait.great_fire.de: Antares, the Great Fire, is the Heart mansion's own star: fire cannot touch her, what she strikes burns, and under the night sky her blows carry the star's heat.
attribute.heartbound.effect.stealth: Hostiles lose sight of her unless she struck within 5s

attribute.heartbound.trait.answering_hea: The other of the two hearts her forms turn between, and the one she was missing: she answers a blow with more than she was given, the Moon Fox she becomes mends her while she fights, and nothing living interrupts her once she has begun.
attribute.heartbound.trait.pillars_acros: What she raises, stands. While there is anything left to fight, three of the Twenty-Eight Mansions rise as Xuanfang pillars and turn around her, a different three every time - and each strikes as its mansion does: the Horn gores through armour, the Tail arcs from foe to foe, the Well opens a healing spring, the Star lands like one. Her own, the Heart, mends her and hers with what it takes.
attribute.heartbound.trait.strings_to_st: The qin and the sword in turn: a sheathed stroke, a drawn one, and the note between them. Every blow she lands is struck as though it were the only one, and more of them find the gap.
attribute.heartbound.trait.severing_note: The note that cuts. What her blow finds is thrown off-tune - weakened for a while, and flung back from her by the force of it.
She rides her sword as easily as she walks: quicker on her feet, a leap that carries her far, and she comes down as lightly as a blade laid on the air.
attribute.heartbound.trait.sea_of_though: Sea of Thought, World of Dust
The Aero at her back, and a mind as still as the sea it thinks in. Arrows and bolts turn aside in the wind that follows her, and no blow, however heavy, moves her from where she stands.
attribute.heartbound.trait.ephemeral_tra: The formless heart, at its height. The nearer she is to falling the sharper she strikes, every blow gives some of its life back to her, and nothing can slow her down. Now and then she ascends, and her swords stop coming home.
After five seconds in a fight: Ascent for 20s (90s cooldown). The Succubus Queen again - wings and crown of soul-fire, three seals and three fireballs a throw that burn through fire resistance, her dread reaching 14 blocks and slowing too. As it ends, a meteor falls where her foes stand thickest.
attribute.heartbound.trait.court_of_bone: In a fight, every 30s two skeletons claw out of hellish rifts to fight for her owner (at most 3, for 40s). They grow with her: their blows are half her attack, and they are sturdier for every level she has. Below 30% health she gives one up: her owner is mended by 15% and she by 10%.
attribute.heartbound.effect.queen_reborn: Ascent after %1$ss in a fight: for %2$ss, three seals and three fireballs a throw that burn through fire resistance, her dread out to %3$s blocks; a meteor as it ends (%4$ss cooldown)
attribute.heartbound.effect.court_of_bon: Every %1$ss in a fight, two skeletons rise for her owner (at most %2$s, for %3$ss), each blow %4$s%% of hers; below %5$s%% health she sacrifices one to mend herself and her owner
attribute.heartbound.trait.billows_benea: Her resonance liberation. When a fight is on her, a sword array opens at her back: four helices of swords climbing into the sky, a seal turning at their crown. Then it lets go - a rain of swords on the ground round her foe, and out of the heart of it her great sword, twenty times itself, falling with them.
attribute.heartbound.effect.liberation: Every %1$ss she opens a sword array; its rain strikes all round her foe for %2$s%% of her blow, again and again, and its great sword for %3$s%%
attribute.heartbound.effect.needs: Bound to the signature %s: a girl without it cannot have this trait, and it does nothing for her
attribute.heartbound.effect.fox_ascent: Ascent under the Heart mansion: for %1$ss its stars stand round her and she fights from range, violet lightning falling on her foe every second and on her blows, leaping on to %2$s more near it; when it ends one great bolt falls there and throws smaller ones out all round - then %3$ss before it can come again
attribute.heartbound.effect.caster: Fights from range: keeps her distance and faces her foe, shooting to help if she has a bow, and closes only when something is on her and she has a weapon
attribute.heartbound.effect.ascent: Ascent: for %1$ss her swords never go home between blows - through her foe, round, and through again, %3$s%% of her blow each time - while twelve more circle her and cut down anything shot at her; no Heaven's Reckoning until it ends, then %2$ss before it can come again
attribute.heartbound.effect.pillars: %1$s mechanisms rise every %2$ss and stand for %3$ss; the first strikes at %4$ss and one more every %5$ss, each for %6$s%% of her blow

attribute.heartbound.trait.thunderclap_s: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. In a fight, every 25s she is at her foe's back in a flash of lightning, and three cuts of thunder follow, each 70% of her attack. A little quicker on her feet, and a little more often a critical.
attribute.heartbound.effect.thunderclap_: Every %1$ss in a fight, a step of lightning to the back of what she fights (within %4$s blocks) and %2$s cuts of thunder, each %3$s%% of her attack.
skill.heartbound.thunderclap_step.desc: You are at the back of what you look at in a flash of lightning, turned to face it, and three cuts of thunder follow, each 70% of your attack. 25 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.glacial_bloom: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. When what she fights is close, every 30s a flower of ice opens out of the ground round her: every foe within 5 blocks is frozen for 4s, slowed for 5s and takes half her attack in frost. She feels no cold, and wears a little armour of it.
attribute.heartbound.effect.glacial_bloo: Every %1$ss in a fight, a flower of ice round her: foes within %2$s blocks frozen for %3$ss, slowed, and struck for %4$s%% of her attack.
skill.heartbound.glacial_bloom.desc: A flower of ice opens round you: every foe within 5 blocks is frozen for 4 s, slowed for 5 s and takes half your attack in frost. 30 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.starfall.desc: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. Every 35s in a fight, five stars fall round what she fights, one after another, each breaking on everything within 2.5 blocks of where it lands for 80% of her attack. Under the open sky only. Her blows are a little heavier.
attribute.heartbound.effect.starfall: Every %1$ss in a fight, %2$s stars fall round what she fights, each %3$s%% of her attack on everything within %4$s blocks of where it lands (under the sky).
skill.heartbound.starfall.desc: Five stars fall round what you look at, one after another, each breaking on everything within 2.5 blocks of where it lands for 80% of your attack. Under the open sky only. 35 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.mirror_veil.d: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. When what she fights is on her: for 8s a veil of mirrors hangs about her - every blow on her does a quarter less, and is answered a moment later by a mirror-image blow on whoever gave it for 60% of her attack. 40s cooldown. A little of every blow is turned back on its giver even without it.
attribute.heartbound.effect.mirror_veil: A veil of mirrors for %1$ss when she is struck at: every blow on her answered by one of %2$s%% of her attack on its giver, and softened by %3$s%%; again %4$ss after.
skill.heartbound.mirror_veil.desc: For 8 s a veil of mirrors hangs about you: every blow on you does a quarter less, and is answered a moment later by a mirror-image blow on whoever gave it for 60% of your attack. 40 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.sanguine_pact: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. In a fight, above half her health, she gives 30% of it: for 10s her blows are half again as hard and each one gives her a quarter of her attack back in life. 45s cooldown. A little harder and a little hungrier for blood even without it.
attribute.heartbound.effect.sanguine_pac: %1$s%% of her health given: for %2$ss her blows %3$s%% harder, each giving back %4$s%% of her attack in life; again %5$ss after.
skill.heartbound.sanguine_pact.desc: Give 30% of your health: for 10 s your blows are half again as hard and each one gives you a quarter of your attack back in life. It will not take the last of you. 45 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.spirit_bell.d: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. Every 30s, when a foe is within 6 blocks or one of hers is ailing there, a bell of the spirit tolls over her: every foe within 6 blocks is stunned for 2s, and she and everyone of hers within it are washed clean of every ill and mended by two hearts. Sturdier, and harder to push about.
attribute.heartbound.effect.spirit_bell: Every %1$ss, a toll that stuns every foe within %2$s blocks for %3$ss and washes every ill off her and hers there, mending them %4$s hearts.
skill.heartbound.spirit_bell.desc: A bell of the spirit tolls over you: every foe within 6 blocks is stunned for 2 s, and you and everyone of yours within it are washed clean of every ill and mended by two hearts. 30 s.
death.attack.heartbound.starfall: %1$s was crushed by a star %2$s called down
death.attack.heartbound.starfall.player: %1$s was crushed by a fallen star while fighting %2$s

item.heartbound.signature_stone.tip: Use on a girl, or in the air on yourself while you are one: choose the signature. Spent in the choosing. Will not change one that is hers by character.
item.heartbound.signature_stone.locked: Her signature is hers by character; the stone will not change it.
screen.heartbound.signature_picker.title: A signature for %s
screen.heartbound.girl_detail.signature_: Hers by character - no stone changes it
msg.heartbound.growth.untransformed: Become a girl first: the stone chooses the signature you carry as her
msg.heartbound.growth.signature_locked: Her signature is hers by character; the stone will not change it
msg.heartbound.growth.signature_chosen: As her, your signature is now %s
item.heartbound.unique_trait_selector.ti: Use on a girl: choose a Unique trait for her fifth or sixth slot. In the air, on yourself: for a slot a crystal has awakened.
msg.heartbound.growth.unique_slot_needed: A Unique goes only into a slot a Unique Awakening Crystal has awakened
attribute.heartbound.trait.phantom_blade: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. When what she fights is within reach: for 6s a shadow of her fights beside her - it opens with three cuts of its own, and every blow she lands after is echoed by one of the shadow's for half her attack. 30s cooldown. Her blows are a little heavier, and hostiles do not notice her until she strikes.
attribute.heartbound.effect.phantom_blad: A shadow beside her for %1$ss when a foe is in reach: %2$s cuts of its own, then every blow of hers echoed for %3$s%% of her attack; again %4$ss after.
skill.heartbound.phantom_blade.desc: For 6 s a shadow of you fights beside you: three cuts of its own on what you look at, then every blow you land is echoed by one of the shadow's for half your attack. 30 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.tidal_crown.d: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. When foes press close, every 30s a wave breaks out from her: every foe within 6 blocks is thrown back, slowed for 4s and struck for 40% of her attack, and everything burning near her is put out. She breathes water, swims fast and fire does her half.
attribute.heartbound.effect.tidal_crown: Every %1$ss when foes press close, a wave: foes within %2$s blocks thrown back, slowed %3$ss, struck for %4$s%% of her attack; fires near her put out.
skill.heartbound.tidal_crown.desc: A wave breaks out from you: every foe within 6 blocks is thrown back, slowed for 4 s and struck for 40% of your attack, and everything burning near you is put out. 30 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.ironwood_bast: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. When a foe is at her, every 30s roots of ironwood burst out of the ground: every foe within 5 blocks is held fast for 3s and struck for 30% of her attack, and bark closes over her and hers there - Resistance II for 8s. Thick-skinned even without it.
attribute.heartbound.effect.ironwood_bas: Every %1$ss when a foe is at her, roots: foes within %2$s blocks held for %3$ss and struck; she and hers there in bark, Resistance II for %4$ss.
skill.heartbound.ironwood_bastion.desc: Roots of ironwood burst out of the ground round you: every foe within 5 blocks is held fast for 3 s and struck for 30% of your attack, and bark closes over you and yours there - Resistance II for 8 s. 30 s.
attribute.heartbound.trait.solar_flare.d: Bound to no signature: any girl may draw it. When a foe is near, every 30s a sun flares over her: every foe within 7 blocks is blinded for 4s, set alight and struck for half her attack - the undead for all of it. Fire does not touch her, and she strikes harder by day.
attribute.heartbound.effect.solar_flare: Every %1$ss when a foe is near, a flare: foes within %2$s blocks blinded %3$ss, set alight and struck for %4$s%% of her attack (undead twice).
skill.heartbound.solar_flare.desc: A sun flares over you: every foe within 7 blocks is blinded for 4 s, set alight and struck for half your attack - the undead for all of it. 30 s.
skill.heartbound.parry_stance.desc: For 3 s no blow by hand lands on you: each is parried and answered with a cut for 150% of your attack. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.cyclone_cut.desc: One turn of the blade through every foe within 4 blocks: 120% of your attack, and they are thrown back. 15 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.storm_call.desc: A bolt of the storm on what you look at (or the nearest foe within 12 blocks), forking onto up to 3 foes within 3 blocks of it: 100% of your attack each, and set alight. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.guillotine.desc: A great blade brought down on a foe within 4 blocks: 200% of your attack, and anything under 35% of its health when it falls is dead. 15 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.backstab.desc: You are at the back of what you look at (within 12 blocks) in a breath of smoke, and your knife is in it for 250% of your attack. 18 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.challenge.desc: Name a foe within 12 blocks: for 8 s it turns on you and no one else, you take 30% less from it, and your blows on it land 30% harder. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.fell_the_giant.desc: A hooked chain at a foe within 8 blocks drags it to your feet: 150% of your attack (double on anything with more than 40 health) and a 2 s stun. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.unstoppable.desc: For 6 s every blow of yours lands at the full double, on anything; Speed I, and nothing shoves you. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.hunters_mark.desc: Mark what you look at (within 24 blocks) for 10 s: it glows wherever it goes, your blows on it land 50% harder, and you have Speed I while it lives. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.devour.desc: Draw the soul out of a foe within 6 blocks: 120% of your attack, and every point of it mends you; a kill wraps you in Absorption II for 10 s. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.iron_hold.desc: Seize a foe within 3.5 blocks in a fist of iron for 3 s: it goes nowhere, 80% of your attack in the closing, and your blows on it land 25% harder. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.mirror_shell.desc: For 5 s a shell of mirror stands about you: every blow on you is thrown back whole at whoever dealt it, and you take half. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.hunting_horn.desc: A call that gives you and everyone of yours within 12 blocks Strength I and Speed I for 10 s; while it sounds every kill of yours is worth 30 experience. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.vanish.desc: For 5 s you are unseen, day or night, and nothing keeps its eyes on you; your first blow out of it lands double and ends it. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.singularity.desc: A well opened where you look (within 12 blocks): for 3 s every foe within 6 blocks of it is dragged into its middle, and then it collapses on them for 100% of your attack. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.shockwave.desc: Everything within 6 blocks is flung away hard, for 80% of your attack, and every arrow in the air about you falls. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.consecrate.desc: The ground 6 blocks about where you stand is holy for 10 s: every undead on it burns and takes 50% of your attack each second, and everyone of yours on it mends. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.disarm.desc: A pulse over 8 blocks: every foe in it has Weakness III for 6 s and forgets what it was after, every creeper is sent off, and every arrow and lit charge in the air drops. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.taunt.desc: A shout that turns every hostile within 12 blocks on you and holds it there for 5 s, while you take 30% less from everything. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.decree.desc: Everything that dreads you within 10 blocks is brought to its knees: Weakness II and Slowness II for 8 s, and unable to move for the first moment; everyone of yours has Strength I for 8 s. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.synchrony.desc: For 10 s every girl of yours within 16 blocks and you move and work as one: Haste II and Speed I, their work inspired the whole while, and Strength I if there is a fight. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.field_dressing.desc: You and everyone of yours within 8 blocks are mended for 30% of your health at once, cleared of every ill, and left with Regeneration II for 5 s. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.rally_march.desc: For 8 s you and everyone of yours within 12 blocks go at the double: Speed II, Jump Boost, and no fall to fear. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.battle_cry.desc: A shout that gives you and everyone of yours within 10 blocks Strength II and Resistance I for 8 s, and takes the fight out of every foe within 8: Weakness for 5 s, and a step back. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.fortunes_favour.desc: For 30 s you and everyone of yours within 8 blocks have Luck III, and every kill you make while it lasts spills 10 experience besides. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.champions_oath.desc: For 60 s you and everyone of yours within 8 blocks are Heroes of the Village III, every villager within 16 blocks is mended and heartened, and every hostile after one of them turns on you instead. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.lantern_light.desc: You and everyone of yours within 12 blocks see in the dark for 60 s, day or night, and every foe within 12 blocks glows for 15 s - and, in the dark, is dazzled for 3 s. 45 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.siren_song.desc: For 6 s every foe within 10 blocks is drawn to you, slow and feeble, forgetting what it was after; any of them in water takes 50% of your attack. Everyone of yours within it breathes water and swims like a dolphin for 30 s. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.rebirth_flame.desc: Fire wraps you: 50% of your health back and every ill burned off, and every foe within 4 blocks is scorched for 100% of your attack and set alight for 4 s. 45 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.stand_firm.desc: For 4 s nothing hurts you and nothing moves you, whatever your health; when it ends you are spent a moment (Slowness, 3 s). 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.smoke_bomb.desc: A burst of smoke where you stood that blinds every foe within 4 blocks for 4 s and makes it forget you, and you are 8 blocks off, away from the nearest of them, before it clears. 30 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.bulldoze.desc: A charge the way you face, Resistance II the while, and every foe you run into is flung aside for 120% of your attack. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.second_wind.desc: Every ill burned off you, and 40% of your health back over 5 s. 40 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.riptide.desc: A surge of water carries you the way you face, on land or in water, and every foe you pass through is swept for 100% of your attack and slowed for 3 s. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.cloak_of_night.desc: For 8 s the dark goes with you wherever you are - half damage and a quarter more pace, in broad day - and every foe within 8 blocks is blind for 3 s and in darkness for 6. 40 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.web_snare.desc: A web thrown over what you look at (within 10 blocks) that holds it and everything within 3 blocks of it fast for 4 s, and you are on it in a bound. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.lava_surge.desc: A wave of magma thrown up before you, 5 blocks along the way you face and 40 degrees to either side: every foe in it takes 120% of your attack in fire and burns for 5 s. Nothing of the world catches. 20 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.flash_freeze.desc: The cold thrown out over 5 blocks: every foe in it is frozen where it stands for 3 s, for 80% of your attack in frost, and every still water in it is ice at once. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.magnetic_pull.desc: Everything within 16 blocks comes to you: every dropped item and orb of experience, every foe within 8 dragged 3 blocks toward you and off its feet, and every arrow in the air turned aside. 25 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.feast.desc: Everyone of yours within 8 blocks is fed full on the spot, with Regeneration I and Absorption I for 10 s on top. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.spiced_meal.desc: A dish for everyone of yours within 8 blocks: Strength I and Speed I for 20 s, and Regeneration I for 5. 60 s cooldown.
skill.heartbound.deep_rest.desc: You drop where you stand and sleep 3 s, unable to move (Resistance II the while), and wake with 50% of your health back, every ill gone and Speed I for 10 s; every foe within 6 blocks is slowed to a crawl while you sleep. 60 s cooldown.
